caveat: This report simulates decision outcomes using existing thresholds. It does not add benchmark evidence or predict the 655M result.

evidence_gaps: gamma-60 balance diagnostic is still pending
scenarios.label: flat 655M
scenarios.recommendation: The 655M quality row does not provide enough evidence by itself; wait for gamma-balance telemetry before launching another expensive broad run.
scenarios.why: No downstream improvement and gamma telemetry still absent.

scenarios.label: saturated 655M, gamma rebalanced
scenarios.recommendation: The Stage-2 marginal gain is weak and gamma-60 rebalances updates. Run a matched 10k-step downstream MNLI row with the balanced coefficient before spending more Stage-2 tokens.
scenarios.why: Stage-2 gain is weak but gamma-60 fixes update balance.

scenarios.label: saturated 655M, gamma still dominated
scenarios.recommendation: The Stage-2 curve appears to saturate and gamma telemetry did not resolve the update imbalance. Stop broad budget scaling and audit recipe alignment.
scenarios.why: Stage-2 gain is weak and gamma-60 does not fix update balance.

scenarios.label: ambiguous mid gain
scenarios.recommendation: Evidence is mixed. Run one narrow ablation at a time: either the next Stage-2 point or one gamma-balanced downstream row, but do not expand axes.
scenarios.why: Improvement exists but is below the meaningful-gain threshold.

scenarios.label: meaningful gain
scenarios.recommendation: Stage-2 still has meaningful marginal gain. Queue the next controlled point before changing the recipe, while keeping gamma telemetry as a diagnostic.
scenarios.why: Stage-2 gain remains large enough to justify another controlled point.

scenarios.label: FP recovery gate
scenarios.recommendation: Do not broaden yet; replicate the recovered row and then run QNLI/SST2 with the same recipe.
scenarios.why: The row reaches the configured within-1pt FP16 recovery gate.
